DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの紛失相談の続きですね。状況に変わりはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are continuing your earlier lost-card consultation. Has anything changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から、自宅の引き出しに私のカードがあったと連絡が来ました。もう見つかったので、停止の依頼をしなくてよいのかと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族が自宅でカード発見と連絡し停止依頼が不要になるのか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family contacted me to say they found my card in a drawer at home. Since it has been found, I came to ask whether I no longer need to request a block.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your family reported finding the card at home, and ask whether the block request is still needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発見の連絡と、こちらへの停止依頼の状況を分けて確認しましょう。ご依頼について控えられたものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the report that it was found separately from the status of your block request here. Do you have a record of the request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談したときの受付番号を控えています。停止がもう済んだのか、依頼を受けただけなのかは、はっきり聞けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号はあるが停止済みか依頼受付のみか聞けていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote down the reference number from the consultation. I have not clearly heard whether the card has already been blocked or whether only the request was received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the reference number but have not confirmed whether the block is complete or only the request has been received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その受付情報を担当が確認します。ご家族が見つけたカードも、今回の対象と同じか照合が必要です。カードは今お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check that reference information. We also need to establish whether the card your family found is the one concerned. Do you have it with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は家にあり、写真もまだ受け取っていません。似たカードかもしれないので、同じカードが確認できたと言い切らないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物は家で写真もなく今回対象と同じカードと断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is at home, and I have not received a photo yet. It could be a similar card, so I will not say that we have confirmed it is the same one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the card is at home, you have no photo, and you cannot be certain it is the card concerned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現物と対象の確認について担当に相談しましょう。見つかったと聞いただけで、そのまま使ってよいとは案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us ask the staff how to check the physical card against the card concerned. We cannot advise you to use it merely because you heard it was found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使えるか試すために引き出すことはしません。家族にもまだ使わず保管してもらい、確認に必要なものを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用確認のため引出しを試さず家族にも保管を頼み確認に必要なものを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not try withdrawing money to test whether it works. I will ask my family to keep it without using it and ask what is needed for the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not test it by making a withdrawal, will ask your family to keep it unused, and want to know what is needed for verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人確認と現物の確認方法を担当がご案内します。再発行の申込みも、別に進められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain identity verification and how to check the physical card. Have you separately applied for a replacement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再発行はまだ申し込んでいません。停止依頼の状況と現物の照合を先に確認し、発見した場合の扱いを聞いてから次の手続きを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再発行未申込で停止状況と現物照合を先に確認し発見時扱いの説明後に次を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not applied for a replacement yet. I will first check the block-request status and match the physical card, then hear how a found card is handled before deciding the next procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not requested a replacement and will first check the block status and physical card, then decide what to do after hearing how a found card is handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では受付番号をもとに担当へおつなぎします。利用再開や停止完了はここでは確定していません。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to the staff member using your reference number. Neither resumption of use nor completion of the block has been confirmed here. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの保存容器についてのご相談ですね。気になるところを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss the food-storage container you brought. What concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で袋を開けたら、ふたの端にひびが見えました。まだ食品は入れていませんが、開封したので相談できないのか気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開封してふたのひびに気づき未使用だが相談可能か気になると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I opened the bag at home, I saw a crack at the edge of the lid. I have not put food in it, but I am worried I cannot ask for help because I opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed a cracked lid after opening the package, have not used it, and wonder whether you can still seek help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開けたことと使用したことは分けて伺います。商品と購入がわかるものを確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will distinguish opening it from using it. May I check the product and something showing the purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容器とふた、袋、レシートを持ってきました。ひびはこの部分です。購入前からあったかまでは見ていなかったので、断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器・ふた・袋・レシートとひびを示し購入前からかは断定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the container, lid, bag, and receipt. The crack is here. I did not check whether it was there before purchase, so I cannot say for certain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the container, lid, bag, receipt, and crack, and explain that you cannot be certain it was there before purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態とご説明を確認します。ご自宅で、洗ったり修理しようとしたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check its condition and your explanation. Did you wash it or attempt to repair it at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 洗っておらず、接着剤なども使っていません。袋から出して見ただけなので、その状態のまま見てほしくて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 洗浄や接着修理をせず見つけた状態で確認してほしいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not washed it or used glue or anything similar. I only took it out of the bag and looked at it, and brought it so you could see it in that condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have neither washed nor glued it and want it checked in the condition in which you found it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご説明を担当に伝え、対応の条件を確認します。交換を希望する場合も、対象商品があるかなどを確認することになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass your explanation to the staff member and check the conditions for assistance. If you want an exchange, we must also check whether the relevant product is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず同じ商品の交換ができるか知りたいです。ただ、同じ物があっても、別のふたを勝手に取って替えるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同商品交換を希望するが別のふたを勝手に取り替えるつもりはないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I would like to know whether I can exchange it for the same product. Even if the same item is available, I do not intend to take another lid and swap it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want an exchange for the same product but will not take and replace another lid without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品は組合せも含めて担当が確認します。回答まで、この一式をどのようにお預かりするかをご案内してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will check the product, including which parts belong together. May I explain how we would hold this set while you await an answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 預けるなら、容器とふたと袋、レシートのどれを預けるかを一緒に確かめたいです。交換が決まる前に別の商品を開けたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預ける容器・ふた・袋・レシートを一緒に確認し未確定で別商品を開けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I leave it here, I want to check together which of the container, lid, bag, and receipt I am leaving. I will not open another product before an exchange is agreed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check together which container, lid, bag, and receipt will be left, and will not open another product before confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では一式を照らし合わせ、預かり方と確認の進め方をご説明します。交換の可否はまだ未確定です。お持ちいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will compare all the items and explain how we will hold them and conduct the check. Whether an exchange is possible is still undecided. Thank you for bringing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先へ進まれる前に、経路について何かお聞きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you go farther, would you like to ask about the route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 奥の広場まで行きたいのですが、一緒に来た人が入口でもう疲れたと言っています。私の速さで一周する予定を立ててしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 奥の広場へ行きたいが同行者は入口で疲れ自分の速さで一周予定を立てたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to reach the plaza farther in, but my companion says they are already tired at the entrance. I planned a full circuit at my own walking speed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to visit the inner plaza, but your companion is tired at the entrance and you planned the circuit at your own pace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予定した一周にこだわらず、まず休める場所を確認しましょう。入口近くの休憩所はこちらの図にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than insisting on the planned circuit, let us first find somewhere to rest. The rest area near the entrance is shown on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まずそこへ一緒に行きます。私だけ先へ行って、後で追い付いてもらうのではなく、休んでから本人に歩けそうか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で先行せず一緒に休憩所へ行き休んでから本人に歩けそうか聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will go there with them first. Instead of going ahead alone and having them catch up later, I want to ask them after resting whether they feel able to walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will go to the rest area together rather than go ahead alone, then ask your companion after resting whether they can walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 休憩後に少し歩くなら、休憩所から短い区間だけ進み、来た道を戻る案もあります。奥の広場まで行く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you walk a little after resting, you could take just a short stretch from the rest area and return the same way. You do not need to reach the inner plaza.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 短い道の途中に階段があるかを教えてください。距離が短くても、同行者が上り下りしづらいなら別の考え方にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短距離でも上り下りしづらい同行者のため階段の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please tell me whether there are stairs on that short route. Even if it is short, I want to choose differently if my companion finds going up and down difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the short route has stairs because your companion may find going up and down difficult even over a short distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内図で示している短い区間には階段の印はありません。ただ、歩きやすさや所要時間を一律に約束するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The short stretch shown on this map has no stair symbol. However, that does not guarantee the same ease of walking or journey time for everyone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 階段の印がないから必ず楽とは決めず、休憩所で本人と話してからにします。入口へ戻る道も同じ図で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 階段印なしでも必ず楽とせず本人と相談し入口への戻り道も示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume it is easy just because there is no stair symbol. I will talk to my companion at the rest area first. Could you also show the way back to the entrance on this map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that no stair symbol does not guarantee ease, that you will consult your companion, and ask to see the way back to the entrance too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩所からこの道を戻ると、いまの入口です。先へ行くことになっても、途中で戻ると決めたら来た道を引き返す案です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Following this path back from the rest area brings you to this entrance. Even if you go farther, the plan is to retrace your steps if you decide to turn back along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 奥の広場を今日の必須の目的地にはしません。休憩所で相談し、短い道へ進むか、そのまま入口へ戻るかを二人で決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 奥の広場を必須にせず休憩後に短い道か入口帰還かを二人で決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not make the inner plaza an essential destination today. After resting, we will decide together whether to take the short path or return directly to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that reaching the inner plaza is optional and that, after resting, you will decide together between the short path and returning to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では最初は休憩所へ向かってください。お連れの方と相談しながら無理のない範囲で。お気をつけてお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please head to the rest area first. Consult your companion and keep within comfortable limits. Take care and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符のご購入ですか。ご利用になる日と人数を先に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you buying tickets? First, please tell me your travel date and how many people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大人二人で明日出かけます。今日買った切符は今日しか使えないのか、気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日利用する大人二人分を今日買いたいと伝え、購入当日だけ有効なのか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two adults are going out tomorrow. I am wondering whether tickets bought today can only be used today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to buy tickets today for two adults travelling tomorrow, and ask whether tickets are valid only on their purchase date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入日と利用日を分けて確認しましょう。行き先のほか、帰りも明日の予定か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish the purchase date from the travel date. Besides your destination, please tell me whether you also plan to return tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行き先はこのメモの駅です。同行者が泊まるかもしれないので、帰りの分はまだ決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メモの駅が行先で、同行者が泊まる可能性があるため帰りの購入はまだ決められないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Our destination is the station on this note. My companion may stay overnight, so I cannot decide about return tickets yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your destination is the station on the note, and you cannot decide about return tickets because your companion may stay overnight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、まず明日の片道二人分について、発売できる種類と条件を調べます。お二人は同じ列車で移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: First I will check the ticket types and conditions available for two one-way journeys tomorrow. Will you both take the same train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行きは一緒です。ただ、会計は別にしたいです。切符も各自が一枚ずつ持つ形にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行きは同じ列車だが別会計にし、各自が一枚の切符を持てるか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will travel together on the way there, but want to pay separately. Can we each have one ticket as well?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take the same outward train but want separate payments, and ask whether each person can hold their own ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お一人分ずつの発売と支払いを確認します。まだ購入は進めませんので、画面に出る利用日と人数を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check issuing and paying for one person's ticket at a time. We are not proceeding with a purchase yet. Could you check the travel date and passenger number on the screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この画面は今日の日付になっています。明日に直し、一人分ずつ買う場合は人数を一人にするのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認画面が今日の日付だと指摘し、明日へ修正して一人分ずつ購入する人数設定を確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This screen shows today's date. We need to change it to tomorrow and, if buying separately, set the number of passengers to one each time, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out that the confirmation screen shows today, and confirm changing it to tomorrow and setting one passenger for each separate purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今は確認用の画面です。実際の購入では切符の種類と合計額も確認します。別会計のご希望も、発売担当に伝える内容へ入れておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. This is only a checking screen. For the actual purchase we will also check the ticket type and total price. I will include your request for separate payments in the information for the ticket-sales staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の分も同行者の分も、明日の日付であることを見てから別々に支払います。帰りの切符は予定が決まってから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人とも明日の日付を確認して別々に支払い、帰りは予定確定後に相談すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will each check that our ticket shows tomorrow before paying separately. I will ask about return tickets once our plans are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that both of you will check tomorrow's date and pay separately, and will ask about the return journey after your plans are settled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。明日の片道を各一人分、別会計をご希望と控えました。この控えをお持ちになって、隣の発売担当へどうぞ。帰りは未定という点も引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I have noted one outward ticket each for tomorrow with separate payments. Please take this note to the sales staff next door. I will also tell them your return plans are undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知が二通ありますね。どちらについてお尋ねになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two notices. Which would you like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ件名なのに、書かれた提出日が違います。先に届いたほうでは準備を始めていて、どちらに合わせるのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ件名の通知で提出日が違い、先着分で準備を始めたためどちらに合わせるか困っていると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: They have the same subject but different submission dates. I already started preparing based on the first one, and do not know which to follow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that notices with the same subject have different submission dates, and you do not know which to follow after starting preparations using the first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付の違う所を一緒に見ましょう。こちらには「訂正」とありますが、封筒と中の紙の組み合わせは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the differing dates together. This one says 'Correction.' Do you remember which paper came in which envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この封筒が後から届いたもので、訂正の紙が入っていました。古い紙はもう捨ててよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訂正の紙が後から届いた封筒のものだと説明し、古い紙を処分してよいか聞く。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This envelope arrived later and contained the correction sheet. Can I throw away the old sheet now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the correction sheet came in the later envelope and ask whether you may discard the old sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が何を訂正したか確認するまでは、二通とも残しましょう。新しい紙のどの点が、準備した内容と合いませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep both until the staff member confirms what was corrected. Which parts of the new sheet differ from what you prepared?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初の紙は写しを一部とありましたが、後の紙は書類名が一つ増えています。提出日だけでなく、持ち物も変わったのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後着の紙には書類名が一つ増えており、提出日と持ち物の両方が変更されたのか確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The first sheet asked for one copy, but the later sheet lists one additional document. I want to ask whether both the submission date and the things to bring changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the later sheet adds one document name, and ask whether both the submission date and required documents have changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出日と追加の書類を、別々の質問として担当へ伝えます。ご本人の通知だと確認できる部分を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass the submission date and additional document as separate questions. Could you show the part confirming that the notice is yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前と照会番号はこの部分です。ほかの家族の情報は折って隠したまま、必要な所だけお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の名前と照会番号を示し、家族情報は隠して必要部分だけ確認してもらう。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name and reference number are here. I will keep the other family members' details folded out of sight and show only what is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your name and reference number, keeping your family's details covered while staff check only the necessary parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な所を確認できました。二通の到着順も含めて担当へ引き継ぎます。回答の内容を控える紙はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked the necessary parts. I will pass this on along with the order in which both notices arrived. Do you have paper to record the answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このメモに、適用される提出日と必要な書類を書き分けます。確認が終わるまでは、古い紙も封筒と一緒に持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 適用される提出日と書類を分けて記録し、確認が済むまで古い紙と封筒を保管すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the applicable submission date and required documents separately on this note. Until the check is finished, I will keep the old sheet together with its envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the applicable submission date and documents separately, and keep the old sheet and envelope until confirmation is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二通ともお持ちになって担当の席へどうぞ。どの記載が訂正されたか、説明を受けてから次の準備を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take both notices to the staff member's desk. Hear which details were corrected before deciding what to prepare next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご来院ですね。問診票を書く前に、今日はどのようなことで受診を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Before you fill in the medical questionnaire, what brings you in today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の手首が痛くて来ました。荷物を持つと痛みますが、いつ始まったかはっきりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右手首が荷物を持つと痛み、開始日は明確でないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right wrist hurts. It hurts when I carry things, but I am not sure when it started.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your right wrist hurts when carrying things and that the starting date is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はっきりした日がわからなくても、そのことを書けます。最初に気になった頃と、その後の変化を覚えている範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write that you do not know the exact date. Please tell me, as far as you remember, when you first noticed it and how it changed afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の週末には気になっていました。昨日は文字を書くときにも痛んだので、その二つを分けて書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先週末には痛みに気づき、昨日は筆記でも痛んだため時期と変化を分けて記入したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had noticed it by last weekend. Yesterday it also hurt when I wrote, so I want to record those two points separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you had noticed the pain by last weekend and it also hurt when writing yesterday, so you want to record the timing and change separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 気づいた頃と、昨日の変化を分けてお書きください。確認書類や、飲んでいる薬がわかる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write when you noticed it separately from yesterday's change. Do you have identification documents and something showing the medicine you take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認書類は持っています。薬は毎晩飲みますが名前が読めません。この袋を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認書類はあるが毎晩飲む薬の名称が読めないので袋を見てほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the identification documents. I take medicine every evening but cannot read its name. Could you look at this bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have identification but cannot read the name of the medicine you take nightly, and ask staff to look at its bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋をお預かりして診療担当へ伝えます。薬の名前を推測で書かなくて大丈夫です。ほかに迷っている項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will take the bag and pass it to the clinical staff. You do not need to guess the medicine's name. Are there any other fields you are unsure about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬のアレルギーの欄です。あると言われた記憶はないのですが、「なし」と言い切れない場合はどう書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬のアレルギーを指摘された記憶はないが「なし」と断言できない場合の記入方法を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The medicine-allergy field. I do not remember being told I have one, but if I cannot confidently say 'none,' what should I write?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to fill in medicine allergies when you do not recall being told of one but cannot firmly state 'none.' Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確かめられていないことを、そのまま「不明」と書いて担当へお伝えください。書かれた内容は診察時にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Write 'unknown' for what has not been established and tell the staff member. The information you write will also be checked during your examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬のアレルギーは不明とし、痛みに気づいた頃と昨日の変化を書きました。薬の名前は袋で確認してもらいたいと添えて提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: アレルギーは不明、痛みの時期と変化は記入済みと整理し、薬の名称は袋で確認を依頼すると添えて提出する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote that medicine allergies are unknown, when I noticed the pain, and yesterday's change. I will submit it with a note asking you to check the medicine name from the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize that allergies are unknown and the pain's timing and change are recorded, and submit it with a request to check the medicine name from its bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診票と袋を受け取りました。診療担当にお伝えします。待っている間に状態が変わったら職員へお知らせください。こちらの席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received the questionnaire and bag and will pass them to the clinical staff. If your condition changes while waiting, please tell a staff member. Please wait in this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの品物をお持ちですね。何を拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought an item to hand in. What did you find?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵が三本付いた輪です。近くの店の入口に落ちていたので、そこの店の鍵かもしれないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三本の鍵が付いた輪を拾い、近くの店の物かもしれないと考えたことを伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a ring with three keys. I found it at the entrance of a nearby shop, so I thought it might belong to that shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you found a ring with three keys and thought it might belong to the nearby shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたの鍵かは、まだわかりませんね。店の中か、外の通路か、拾った場所を詳しく教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We do not yet know whose keys they are. Please describe precisely whether you found them inside the shop or in the passage outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の中ではなく、入口から少し離れた外の通路です。青い鉢の横で、午後二時半ごろ拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店内でなく入口から少し離れた外の通路の青い鉢の横で午後二時半ごろ拾ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not inside the shop, but in the outside passage a little away from the entrance. I found them beside a blue plant pot at about 2:30 p.m.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found them around 2:30 p.m., beside a blue pot in the outside passage a little away from the entrance, rather than inside the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所と時刻を記録します。店の方には何かお話しになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record the place and time. Did you speak to anyone at the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 落とした人を知っているかだけ尋ねましたが、わからないと言われました。鍵を使ってどこか開けたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店へ持ち主を尋ねたが不明だったことと、鍵を使って何か開けてはいないことを伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only asked whether they knew who had dropped them, but they said they did not. I have not used the keys to open anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the shop did not know the owner when you asked and that you have not used the keys to open anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯も記録します。鍵束には赤い札が一枚ありますね。拾ったときから付いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that too. There is one red tag on the key ring. Was it attached when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。赤い札も輪も、そのままです。家に帰ってから届けたのではなく、拾った後はこの窓口へ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤い札と輪は拾ったままで、帰宅を挟まず窓口へ来たと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The red tag and ring are unchanged. I did not go home before handing them in; I came to this counter after finding them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the red tag and ring are as found and you came to the counter without going home first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 経路も確認できました。こちらの記録の場所と時刻を見直してください。ご連絡先はこの用紙に記入していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have also checked your route. Please review the recorded place and time. You can fill in your contact details on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時刻は二時半ごろで合っています。場所は店内ではないともう一度書いてください。連絡先を記入して、この鍵束をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻を確認し、場所が店外の通路であると記録に明記してもらい、連絡先を記入して鍵束を渡す。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: About 2:30 is correct. Please write again that the location was not inside the shop. I will fill in my contact details and hand over these keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the time, ask for the record to specify the passage outside the shop, fill in contact details, and hand over the keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 店の外の通路と追記し、鍵束を受け取りました。この後の確認事項はこちらでご説明しますので、記録を見ながらお聞きください。お届けにご協力いただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have added 'passage outside the shop' and received the keys. I will explain the remaining matters to check, so please listen while looking at the record. Thank you for helping hand them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越し後の郵便についてですね。これまでのお住まいから、どなたが移られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss mail after moving. Who will move from your current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私一人が移ります。同居している姉は今の家に残るので、姉の郵便まで新居へ来るのは困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分だけ転居し姉は旧住所に残るため、姉の郵便まで転居先へ来ないよう相談したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I am moving. My older sister will stay in our current home, so it would be a problem if her mail came to my new home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you are moving and your older sister will remain at the old address, and ask how to avoid having her mail sent to your new home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象者を区別する必要がありますね。以前の住所と新しい住所は、部屋番号までわかる資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to distinguish who is covered. Do you have documents showing both addresses, including the room numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旧住所は書けます。新住所はこの契約の控えにありますが、建物名の後の三〇五が部屋番号でよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所は書けるが新住所の建物名に続く三〇五が部屋番号なのか迷うと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can write the old address. The new one is on this contract copy, but I am unsure whether the 305 after the building name is the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can write the old address but are unsure whether 305 following the new building name is the room number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この控えでは三〇五号室とあります。申込内容へ写す前に、ご自身でもご確認ください。今回はご本人分の扱いを担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This copy says Room 305. Please check it yourself before copying it into the application. We will ask the staff about handling mail for you alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新住所の三〇五号室まで書きます。対象者は私だけと伝えたいので、姉の名前も申込欄に並べるべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所は三〇五号室まで書くと確認し、対象を自分だけにするため姉の名前も申込欄へ並べるべきか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write the new address through Room 305. Since I want to specify only myself, should I also list my sister's name in the application field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will include Room 305, and ask whether you should also list your sister's name in order to cover only yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 残る方を含め、誰をどの欄に書くかは記入案内を担当と確認しましょう。推測で二人を同じ対象欄へ書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the instructions with the staff about whose names go in which fields, including the person staying. Do not guess and put both names in the same covered-person field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 対象欄はまだ埋めず、姉が残る事情を先に説明します。申し込んだその日から届き先が変わるとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象欄を推測で埋めず姉が残ると先に説明し、申込当日から反映されるとは限らないと確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave that field blank and first explain that my sister is staying. It does not necessarily change the delivery destination on the day I apply, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not guess when filling in the covered-person field and will explain that your sister is staying; confirm that changes may not take effect on the application day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 反映の時期も確認が必要です。急ぐ郵便がある場合は、その差出人への住所連絡も別に考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The effective date also needs checking. If any mail is urgent, separately consider notifying its sender of your address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 来月の勤務書類が届く予定なので、会社へ新住所を直接知らせます。ここでは対象が私だけであることと、開始時期を確認してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来月の勤務書類のため会社へ直接新住所を知らせ、郵便の申込対象と開始時期を確認してから申請すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I expect work documents next month, so I will tell my company the new address directly. Here I will apply after confirming that only I am covered and when it starts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will directly notify your company for next month's work documents, and apply for mail handling after checking who is covered and when it begins. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 照会したい点がまとまりましたね。この記入案内と住所の控えを持って担当へどうぞ。お姉様が残る事情も引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have organized the questions. Please take these instructions and the address copy to the staff member. I will also tell them that your older sister is staying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の途中で進めなくなったとのことですね。どの画面で止まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You could not continue your address change. Which screen stopped you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 確認の番号を受け取る画面です。表示される携帯番号は前のもので、今は使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更が認証画面で止まり、表示される旧携帯番号をもう使えないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen for receiving the verification number. It shows my previous mobile number, which I can no longer use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the address change stopped at verification and that you can no longer use the old mobile number displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い連絡先への認証が残っているのですね。今の電話番号への変更も含めて担当に相談しましょう。確認用の番号そのものは口頭で伝えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Verification is still linked to your old contact number. Let us ask the staff about changing it to your current number too. Do not say the verification number itself aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号を誰かに受け取ってもらう方法は使わず、連絡先の変更を相談します。新しい携帯と、本人確認書類を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他人に認証を受け取ってもらわず連絡先変更を相談すると述べ、新携帯と本人確認書類を提示する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not have someone else receive the number for me; I will ask about changing my contact details. I brought my new mobile phone and identification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask to change contact details rather than have someone else receive verification, and show your new phone and identification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちの物でどの確認が必要か、担当がご案内します。新住所が確認できる書類もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will explain what checks are required using what you brought. Do you also have a document showing the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。ただ、住所変更だけ先に終わったつもりになっていました。電話番号と住所は、両方の手続き状況を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の書類はあるが住所変更が終わったと思い込んでいたと説明し、電話番号と住所を別々に確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. However, I had assumed the address change alone was already complete. I want to ask about the status of both the phone-number and address procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a new-address document but mistakenly assumed the address change was complete, and want the phone number and address checked separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つを分けて確認してもらいましょう。操作途中の表示は完了の証明とは限りません。郵送物についてもご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us have those checked separately. A display partway through an operation is not necessarily proof of completion. Do you have any preferences about mailed notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今後の通知は新住所へ届くようにしたいです。郵便の転送を頼んでも、銀行の登録が自動で変わるわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今後の通知を新居で受けたいと伝え、郵便の転送だけでは銀行登録が自動変更されないと確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want future notices to arrive at my new address. Requesting mail forwarding does not automatically change the bank's registration, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want future notices at your new home and confirm that mail forwarding alone does not automatically change the bank's records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の手続きです。登録の変更と、いつの通知から新住所になるかを担当にご確認ください。質問をこの紙にまとめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: They are separate procedures. Please check the registration change and which notices will first use the new address with the staff. You can list your questions on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話番号の変更方法、住所変更の受付状況、通知の送付先の三つを書きました。認証の番号は書かず、この紙で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話番号変更・住所変更受付・通知送付先の三点を紙にまとめ、認証番号は書かず相談すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote three points: how to change my phone number, the acceptance status of my address change, and the destination of notices. I will use this paper to ask, without writing the verification number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your paper lists phone-number changes, address-change acceptance, and notice destination, and that you will ask without recording the verification number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご質問とお持ちの書類を担当に引き継ぎます。連絡先の変更が済んだと決めつけず、説明を受けながら進めてください。こちらの席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your questions and documents to the staff member. Proceed with their explanation without assuming your contact details have already changed. Please come to this seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのソースの表示で、お探しの項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a particular part of that sauce label you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の冷蔵庫が小さいので、常温で置ける物を探しています。この瓶は開けた後も常温でよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷蔵庫が小さいため常温品を探し、瓶入りソースが開封後も常温でよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My refrigerator is small, so I am looking for something I can keep at room temperature. Can this bottled sauce also stay at room temperature after opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a room-temperature product because your refrigerator is small, and ask whether this bottled sauce can stay that way after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの常温保存という欄は未開封時のものです。開封後の欄は、ふたの近くにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This room-temperature storage field applies before opening. The instructions for after opening are near the lid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開封後は冷蔵と書いてありますね。大きい瓶を少しずつ使うつもりでしたが、全部を棚に置くのは違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封後冷蔵の表示を読み、大瓶を少量ずつ使って棚に置く考えは表示と違うと確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says refrigerate after opening. I planned to use a large bottle a little at a time, but keeping the whole bottle on a shelf would not follow the label, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the refrigerate-after-opening instruction and confirm that using a large bottle gradually while keeping it on a shelf conflicts with the label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品では表示を分けてご覧ください。どれくらいの量を使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish the two instructions for this product. How much do you expect to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度の料理で少ししか使いません。冷蔵庫に入る小さい物か、使い切りの袋があれば比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一度に少量しか使わないため、冷蔵庫に入る小型品か使い切り袋を比較したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I use only a little in each meal. I would like to compare a small product that fits in the refrigerator with single-use sachets, if available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you use only a little at a time and want to compare a small product that fits your refrigerator or single-use sachets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 隣に小分けの袋があります。ただ、瓶と同じ名前でも原材料が同じとは限りません。こちらの欄をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are small sachets next to it. However, even with the same name as the bottle, the ingredients may differ. Please look at this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 瓶にはない調味料の名前が袋にはあります。この言葉が読めないので、同じ中身だと思って選ぶのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋には瓶にない読めない調味料名があり、同名商品を同じ内容と思って選ばないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The sachet lists a seasoning that is not on the bottle. I cannot read this word, so I will not choose it assuming the contents are the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the sachet has an unreadable seasoning name absent from the bottle, and you will not assume products with the same name have identical contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読めない点はお問い合わせ先に確認できます。今日は購入を見送ることもできますし、別の商品を調べることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the unreadable item with the listed contact. You may decide not to buy today or investigate another product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこの二つは買いません。わからない原材料の名前を控え、家で確認してから、量と開封後の保存方法も含めて選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は二品とも買わず、不明な原材料を確認後に量と開封後の保存条件を含めて選び直すと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy neither of these today. I will note the unknown ingredient name, check it at home, and choose again considering the quantity and storage after opening too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy neither today and, after checking the unknown ingredient, choose again based on quantity and storage conditions after opening as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品は棚へお戻しいただいて大丈夫です。表示の場所がまたわからなくなったらお声がけください。お買い物ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You may return the products to the shelf. If you cannot find the label information again, please ask. Thank you for shopping with us.
